# Description
Turnfight is an online multiplayer aircraft combat game.

To learn more about the game, visit the [help page](/help/).
translations.privacy_md:
# Introduction
We collect information to provide, measure, and improve services for all our users. Generally speaking, the amount of personal information we collect is minimal, and you can opt out of providing most of it.

If you are under 18 years of age, we require that you avoid sharing your real name or other personal information in-game, and we recommend asking a trusted adult to help interpret the following information.

# Information we collect
|Information|Collection method|Suggested opt-out method|Primary purpose|Storage duration|
|-|-|-|-|-|
|Alias|Splash screen|Leave blank|Differentiate between players|Forever, e.g. with leaderboard score|
|Team name|Team panel|Don't make team|Differentiate between teams|Forever, e.g. with leaderboard score|
#ifdef chat
|Chat messages|Chat panel|Don't send any|Allow and moderate player communication|Forever, until manually deleted|
#endif
|IP address|Game server|Use a VPN|Security|Forever, e.g. with chat message|
|User agent, referrer|Game server|Use a browser extension to hide|Aggregate or anonymous metrics|Forever|
|How long you play, FPS|Game server|N/A|Aggregate or anonymous metrics|Forever|
#ifdef accounts
|User name|Profile|Don't sign in|Sign in process|Forever, unless you delete your account|
|Nick name|Profile|Leave blank, or don't sign in|Differentiate between players|Forever, unless you delete it|
#ifdef avatar
|Avatar image|Profile|Leave blank, or don't sign in|Differentiate between users|Forever, until manually deleted in Profile|
#endif
|Other information you provide|Profile and Store|Leave blank|Various|Forever, until manually deleted in Profile or Store|
#endif

We do not collect geolocation data or automatically process any data to "profile" you.

# Information we store on your computer
Some game settings, such as language and volume level, are stored in your browser's local storage. To ensure the continuity and consistency of your experience, and provide for internal operations, we store a persistent session identifier in your browser's local storage. We do not use this identifier for advertising purposes.

#ifdef cookie_consent
You can revoke consent for particular non-essential cookies in [settings](/settings/), in which case they will be stored in volatile session storage (not stored on your device).
#endif

You can reset or clear any or all cookies or local storage, at any time, by using your browser's "clear site data" option.

# Information we share with 3rd parties
#ifdef chat
We share your chat messages, including team/whisper chat, with volunteer moderators to help limit inappropriate messages.
#endif

We also use third party services that use cookies, local storage, and/or web beacons for the purpose of online, multi-site behavioral advertising and analytics. This services may collect, share, and/or sell your personal information according to their own privacy policies. We make best efforts to forward, to you, all attempts by such services to obtain your consent or privacy preferences.

# Changes
We reserve the right to alter these privacy policies at any time, without notice.

#ifdef contact_info
# Contact Us
If you have any concern, such as a desire to remove your nickname or your child's nickname from the leaderboard, please contact us by email at [email] or by postal mail at Softbear, Inc. 14150 NE 20th Street #F1-315 Bellevue WA 98007 USA.
#endif
translations.help_md:
# Controls

- Use the **mouse** to adjust your **view and aircraft orientation**
- Exception: Holding **right-click** or enabling keyboard-only controls mean the mouse doesn't affect orientation
- **Left click** or press **Space** to fire primary **weapons**
- Press **W and S** to pitch **down and up**
- Press **A and D** to yaw **left and right**
- Press **Q and E** to roll **left and right**
- Press **Tab** and **Shift** to increase and decrease **throttle**
- Press **R to reload** weapons
- Press **1, 2, or 3** to select an available **upgrade**

# Aiming

Remember to aim ahead of your target, especially by using the 'lead' indicator icon. If you don't see the icon, the target may not be in range. Lower level aircraft can't be aimed too
far away from their current orientation.

# Score

- During level 1, you earn points simply for surviving until level 2
- If you destroy an enemy aircraft, you get a fraction of their score
- If you destroy a submarine or balloon (the former requires cannon), you get a one-time bonus
- If you capture a submarine or balloon (by staying nearby for a while), you get a recurring bonus
- If your aicraft is destroyed, you lose a fraction of your score

# Instruments

You can learn more about the status of your aircraft by checking instruments in the bottom right corner:
- **THR**: throttle
- **IAS**: indicated airspeed
- **ALT**: altitude
- **MG**: machine-gun ammo
- **CNN**: cannon ammo, more damaging than machine-gun

# Caution and warnings

In hazardous situations, a warning may be displayed in the center of the screen:
- **Out of bounds**: too far from center of world
- **Stall**: insufficient airspeed, compromising maneuverability
- **Hypoxia**: excessive altitude
- **Over G**: excessive G-force due to aggressive maneuvering

# Teams

While playing, you can press Escape to allow your mouse to interact with the team
menu in the upper left. Teams share a single score. When a member dies, the score
fraction transferred is lower when there are more members.
